annotations.title: Scan a wallet for a launch tool (Proxima, BlockX)

description: Whether a Solana wallet launched or traded memecoins with a launch kit, Proxima (proxima.tools) or BlockX, with the evidence. Proxima: its sell fees, its cut of pump.fun creator-fee claims and its receipt round trips. BlockX: its fee inside each trade, its nonce relay funding, its cash-outs through nonce accounts and its sweep of their rent. Lists the tokens the wallet launched and the relays tipped, the sells the tool took its fee on, each fee wallet (what it was paid, its balance now, whether it ever sent anything out), the creator-fee claims, and the tree of wallets that funded it, walked up to its root funder with what Iris knows of that root. A token's mint scans its creator. Free with an API key, or without one $0.02 paid per call with x402; never settled if it fails. Can take up to two minutes.

mint.description: Optional: narrow the report to this token (base58 mint).

wallet.description: The Solana wallet (a dev or trader), or a token's mint to scan its creator (base58).
